description: Manage an existing calendar event (destructive: covers update/decline/cancel/delete — use dryRun where supported to preview). action=`update` edits fields in place via PATCH (subject, start, end, attendees, body, location, isOnlineMeeting, sensitivity, showAs, importance, categories, reminderMinutesBeforeStart) — only fields you pass are changed; pass `dryRun: true` to preview the PATCH payload. action=`decline` declines an invitation (optional `comment`). action=`cancel` cancels an event you organised and notifies attendees. action=`delete` permanently removes the event. Returns the updated event on update; status confirmation otherwise. Note: there is no `accept` action — accept invitations in the Outlook UI (Graph's accept verb is unreliable across personal/M365).

attendees.description: Full replacement attendee list — pass complete desired list, or [] to clear (action=update only)

categories.description: Full replacement category list — pass [] to clear (action=update only)

comment.description: Optional comment for declining or cancelling the event

dryRun.description: Preview the PATCH without applying it (action=update only). Returns the body that would be sent to Graph.

end.description: New end time as ISO 8601 string or {dateTime, timeZone} object (action=update only)

id.description: Alias for `eventId` (canonical per the v3.7.3 alias pass).

reminderMinutesBeforeStart.description: Minutes before start to fire the reminder (action=update only)

showAs.description: Free/busy status shown to others (action=update only)

start.description: New start time as ISO 8601 string or {dateTime, timeZone} object (action=update only)

name: manage-event
